change.gameplayImpact: Rengar was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug that caused him to be unable to extend his passive duration with attacks.

lines.label: Base damage
lines.note: Base damage changed to 20–160 from 30–150.

lines.label: AD ratio
lines.note: AD ratio changed to 5% AD at all ranks from 0–15% AD.

lines.label: Empowered base damage
lines.note: Empowered base damage increased to 35–12 from 30–12.

lines.label: Empowered AD ratio
lines.note: Empowered AD ratio reduced to 20% AD from 30% AD.
